title: OnToPilot RDF migration manifest
description: Output of RdfMigrationCommand.VerifyCopyAsync: the 5-field RdfMigrationReport record (Strategy, QuadCount, NamedGraphs, QueryResultHashes, WriteRevertPassed). Task 4's Assert-AllMigrationManifests gate loads this file and validates its shape and content before allowing the cutover to proceed.

Strategy.description: Which verification path produced this report: 'direct' (OxigraphStore.OpenReadOnly on the copy) or 'nquads' (Load(N-Quads) on a fresh store at the work path). The two paths must produce identical manifest hashes for the same logical content.

QuadCount.description: Total quads observed on the chosen strategy. Must be > 0 for the cutover to proceed.

NamedGraphs.description: Distinct named graphs, sorted ascending by IRI.

QueryResultHashes.description: Per-query SHA-256 over the JSON-serialized result set (deterministic; Oxigraph's QuerySolutions.Serialize with the JSON format). Each key is a smoke-query name (e.g. 'all-quads', 'tbox-only'); each value is a 64-char lowercase hex digest.

WriteRevertPassed.description: True when WriteRevertSmokeAsync (add probe quad -> ClearGraph) succeeded; false otherwise. Must be true for the cutover to proceed.
